structured.answer: I'd rather see option א: one tall column for each account with the big number underneath, 66,513 ₪ against 19,595 ₪, "נשאר בידיים". The steps in ב jump up and down and put the red minus right in front of me. From that, joining looks worth it, because the employer puts in 54,000 ₪ when I put in 18,000 ₪. But I would still ask the clerk at the bank.

stuck.where: Top of the page, the small dark picture under 'מה היה'
stuck.why: Tiny text and rows of dots. I couldn't read any of it, and for a moment I thought that was the chart I was meant to judge.

stuck.where: Example line with S&P500, the codes (13245) and 'קרן מחקה'
stuck.why: English letters and words I don't know. It looked like shares, and I nearly left.
A minus in red made me stop. Only later did I see 'לפני 6 שנים: מס', so the tax only applies if you take the money out early.

stuck.where: The same chart shown again for year 6 in option א
stuck.why: Suddenly the minus is '0 ₪' and the total is 98,738 ₪. It took me a while to see that this is year 6 and not year 5.
